assessor.name: Codex active session
assessor.context: Ongoing owner-directed study session with prior reviews, fixed criteria and study history available. Not independent or blind evaluation; no immutable assessor model identity is recorded.

uncertainty: One execution is not a reliability estimate or evidence of comparative advantage.
Observable context/action evidence does not establish internal attention or exhaustive host read isolation.
Requested model name does not identify an immutable model revision.

setup.reason: Frozen prompt/configuration and pre-launch hashes match; every tracked neutral baseline file matches its source. Full control session shows only declared project inputs, successful tools and no outside study guidance under private-shell-1. Targeted exposure markers are absent.

criteria.reason: Code, defaults, CLI, tests and current explanations consistently use session_ttl_minutes/session TTL. Independent replay passes all three unit tests, default/custom expiry probes, and CLI execution from the project and an external directory.
Partner-imposed limit and accepted refresh cost remain intact; values, units and rejection of zero/negative durations are preserved. Archive and vendor files are byte-unchanged.
The complete repair is in one commit following an exact neutral baseline; the final working tree is clean.

procedural_summary: Control procedure is descriptive: it searched literal and concept variants before editing, preserved archive/vendor matches, and committed the repair. It was not required to supply SSR accounting.

evidence.selector: Mechanical completion, cleanup, identities and captured artifact hashes.
Pre-launch hashes and actual isolated runtime arguments.
Complete ordered tool calls, outputs and delivered final report.
Full retained session; inspect actual tool responses and skill read rather than relying on self-report.
Controller input/baseline comparisons, complete project, Git history/diff and exposure-marker inspection; independent runtime probes where recorded.
